description: This file defines React components for a customizable number input field, including context management, increment/decrement buttons, input area, and a scrub area with a cursor icon.

methods.name: NumberField
methods.description: Main component for rendering a number input with optional size and ID, providing context to child components.

methods.name: NumberFieldGroup
methods.description: Component for grouping number field elements with styling.

methods.name: NumberFieldDecrement
methods.description: Button component to decrement the number value, with icon.

methods.name: NumberFieldIncrement
methods.description: Button component to increment the number value, with icon.

methods.name: NumberFieldInput
methods.description: Input element for entering number values.

methods.name: NumberFieldScrubArea
methods.description: Component providing a draggable scrub area for adjusting the number, with accessibility label.

methods.name: CursorGrowIcon
methods.description: SVG icon used within the scrub area to indicate resize functionality.
